notes: Applicability caveat from the source page itself, carried on file: the page states these serial styles were found for Fedders-Airwell and, although unconfirmed, it is believed all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles. That is a brand-applicability scope caveat, so the text-verified style ships with the caveat, not held. Only style 2 ships, year-only: its year digits are stated in page text and its month letter is chart-only. Style 1 is HELD despite text-stated week/year positions because its 12-character shape (2 letters, 9 digits, 1 letter) collides exactly with held chart-only style 3. Styles 3, 4 and 5 decode only via chart images and are held.

styles.era: 8-character serials: two year digits, one letter, five digits
styles.notes: Year is the 1st and 2nd characters per page text. Month is the 3rd character via a chart image (FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg) that cannot be read here, so month is held, not guessed; file is year-only. Page example carries a dash; normalization strips it. Shape is disjoint from held styles 1/3 (12 characters), 4 (starts with three letters) and 5 (7 characters).
